en: Seeds sprout in the beds all by themselves, faster and faster. You can't stop them!
Each plant shows what it needs: a water drop or a sun. Pick that tool and tap the plant.
Three good feeds and it blooms. Pick the basket and harvest it!
Tap snails to send them home before they nibble your plants.
If a need waits too long, the plant wilts. 3 wilted plants and it is over.
and carry on with 1 heart; every plant's wait resets and the snails go home
